title: First Matabele War
summary: Wikidata item Q857982, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (named for this item in data/imports/wikidata-seeds.json): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.

retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 11 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1370619474, argues the war out of the British South Africa Company's 1889 royal charter, the Pioneer Column of 1890 and Lobengula's raid on a Mashona chief near Fort Victoria, and forward to the Second Matabele War; this atlas holds none of them and no record in southern Africa before 1953 but the Boer wars, which the article does not mention. It names no event this corpus has.
